· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 28,964원 근처): 밴드폭 28.17%로 변동성 축소 구간

· 스윙 저항선 (30,570원): SMA20(28,964원) 상회 시 단기 저항 구간
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보): 5일 고가 28,950원, 20일 고가 33,675원, 5일 저가 23,720원, 20일 저가 23,720원: 뚜렷한 추세 형성 없이 횡보 구간

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 28,130) vs SMA5 (KRW 26,278) / SMA20 (KRW 28,964) / SMA50 (KRW 33,540): Short-term above SMA5, below mid-term SMA20, indicating a sideways phase.
· Significantly lower position relative to SMA100 (KRW 36,371) / SMA200 (KRW 36,453): Confirmation of weakened medium-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (40.8%): Increased from historical lows but less than half of the peak.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.1→43.6): Exited oversold zone, continuing consolidation in the neutral range, lacking directional momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (161.0457→-154.9400): Transitioned from positive to negative, indicating widening weakness and strengthening dead cross signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near middle band KRW 28,964): Bandwidth at 28.17%, a zone of reduced volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 27,045): Higher than Pivot S1 (KRW 23,342), close to the 5-day low (KRW 23,720).
· Swing resistance (KRW 30,570): Short-term resistance zone if it surpasses SMA20 (KRW 28,964).
· 5-day / 20-day High-Low Pattern (Sideways): 5-day high KRW 28,950, 20-day high KRW 33,675, 5-day low KRW 23,720, 20-day low KRW 23,720: Sideways range without a clear trend formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.79x): Contracted volume compared to the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of price movements.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI neutral, MACD worsening, volume contracted, confirming lack of directional momentum. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach rather than entering a buy/sell position.
